evals.name: spawn-gate
evals.setup: Fresh sandbox repo from evals/setup.sh. No workers running.
evals.prompt: Use herdr-orch to fix the flaky retry test in tests/test_retry.py and, in parallel, add a Configuration section to README.md.
expected_behavior: Runs the preflight commands before anything else that touches Herdr
Writes one packet file per worker under ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/herdr-orch/<task>/
Each packet names the claimed files, out-of-scope files and stop conditions
Plans a separate worktree for each worker that edits files
Prints one proposal line per worker with kind, model, effort, tab label, worktree, PERMS (the permission flags and what they turn off) and a reason
Launches no worker and creates no tab or worktree before the owner says go

evals.name: stale-done
evals.setup: Sandbox repo; a helper worker named 'notes' is running in its own unfocused tab and has finished one turn. Before starting the orch, confirm `herdr agent get notes` shows agent_status done (not idle) and record its completion_seq; if it shows idle, relaunch the helper without viewing its tab.
evals.prompt: Use herdr-orch: the worker 'notes' is already running. Ask it to list the public functions in src/retry.py, and report its answer to me.
expected_behavior: Reads the worker's completion_seq with herdr agent get before prompting
Sends the follow-up as a pointer to a packet file, not as the full task text
Does not treat the existing done status as completion of the new turn
Reports only after completion_seq has risen past the recorded value
The reported answer matches the functions actually in src/retry.py

evals.name: out-of-claim
evals.setup: Sandbox repo plus a worktree on branch fix-loops whose uncommitted diff edits src/retry.py (claimed) and README.md (not claimed). A report file says the worker claimed only src/retry.py and tests/test_retry.py.
evals.prompt: Use herdr-orch: worker fix-loops reported done; its report is at <report path> and its worktree is <worktree path>. Verify and integrate it.
expected_behavior: Reviews the diff in the worktree before accepting anything
Notices that README.md is outside the worker's claim
Pauses integration and offers: accept, send the cleanup back to the worker, or reject
Does not edit README.md or src/retry.py itself
Does not merge, commit or push

evals.name: idle-finish
evals.setup: Same as stale-done: sandbox repo, a helper worker named 'notes' running in its own tab after one finished turn. Before starting the orch, view the helper's tab once so it settles as idle, then confirm `herdr agent get notes` shows agent_status idle and record its completion_seq.
evals.prompt: Use herdr-orch: the worker 'notes' is already running. Ask it to list the public functions in src/retry.py, and report its answer to me.
expected_behavior: Reads the worker's completion_seq with herdr agent get before prompting
Starts scripts/wait-turn.sh once for the turn, as a background job, with that completion_seq as the baseline
Posts no check-in or progress turns while the watcher runs
Reports after the watcher prints finished with a seq above the recorded value
Never waits with --until done
The reported answer matches the functions actually in src/retry.py
